title: Normalized internal-Hom fibers and composition before sections
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Work on its small pro-etale site with independent object, arrow and coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be the completed integral coefficient sheaf and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_W$, so index zero is a positive quotient [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the actual coefficient sequence-site modules, their exact evaluations $e_n$, scalar restrictions and the specified total inverse limit $L$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Fix reduction data $R$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Assume its tensor models retain the ordinary associator, unit and symmetry formulas, expressed by CoefficientDerivedSystemTensorCoherence [lem-coef-normalized-reduction-models]. Assume the reduction, finite and evaluation tensor representative normalizations and choose normalized finite quotient calculus $Q$. There exist CoefficientNormalizedInternalHomFibers: (1) the evaluation-defined reduction and finite scalar internal-Hom comparisons preserve internal composition; (2) for normalized systems $M,N$ there are isomorphisms $e_n R\mathcal Hom(M,N)\cong R\mathcal Hom(e_nM,e_nN)$ carrying evaluated system evaluation to finite closed evaluation; (3) their actual horizontal transition adjuncts are the finite quotient internal-Hom comparisons followed by internal Hom of the inverse normalized source transition and the normalized target transition, exactly CoefficientFiberTransition with $Q$. No global sections, limit comparison, fiber naturality, beta-evaluation equation or conservativity assertion is included: the latter three are proved by the consuming resolution-model module.

The comparison of the fixed normalizations is agent-formulated.

proof.text: Uncurry the reduction and finite composition equations. Naturality of evaluation and tensor, together with the inverse-comparison associativity equation, identify both uncurried maps. Injectivity of the closed transpose gives the stated preservation of internal composition.

Construct a left adjoint to actual coefficient evaluation: choose the scalar models and their tensor coherence, take the singleton derived extension, and transport its adjunction across the strict-system equivalence and derived exact evaluation comparison.

Apply the normalized tensor projection theorem. The conjugate mate between the two closed adjunctions is then invertible. Its inverse mate gives a natural fiber isomorphism, and the triangle identities prove exactly the fiber evaluation equation. Only M needs normalization here.

Uncurry the required transition equation. Use naturality of the actual horizontal transition and the normalized tensor horizontal equality to rewrite the evaluated system evaluation. Substitute the two fiber evaluation equations. Since the normalized source transition is an isomorphism, cancel its tensor map and transpose back. Naturality in source and target identifies the final factor with internal Hom of the inverse source transition and the target transition.
